What we actually fix

Concrete, real-world breakages — not vague "digital transformation."

Zapier & Make failures

Multi-step Zaps and Make scenarios that silently stopped firing, error out, or skip steps.

Broken webhooks & APIs

Webhooks that no longer deliver, expired tokens, and integrations that 401 or time out.

API & schema drift

A vendor changed a field or endpoint and your automation has been quietly mapping the wrong data.

Duplicate & missing records

Dedup logic that never worked, records dropped on the floor, or rows written twice.

Cron & Python scripts

Scheduled scripts that fail at 2am, crash on a bad input, or never got proper error handling.

Data extraction & cleanup

PDFs, spreadsheets, and exports that need reliable extraction, validation, and de-duplication.

How it works

Simple. No jargon. No surprises.

1

You describe the problem

Fill out the form or send an email. Tell us what's broken, what it should do, and how urgent it is.

No technical write-up required — a screenshot and a sentence is enough to start.

2

Diagnosis and quote

viabolat reviews your setup, identifies the root cause, and sends a fixed-price quote within 24 hours. No hourly surprises.

You see the real cause and the exact price before any work begins.

3

Fixed. Documented. Maintained.

You get a working system, full documentation, and the option for a monthly maintenance plan so it never breaks again.

Every fix ships with a 14-day bug warranty and a plain-English handoff.

Frequently asked questions

The things people ask before they get in touch.

Most fixes turn around in 48–72 hours once scope is agreed. Larger rebuilds are delivered in 7–10 days. You'll always get a fixed-price quote within 24 hours of describing the problem.

Yes. You approve a fixed price before any work starts — no hourly meters, no surprise invoices. If the scope genuinely changes, we agree a new fixed price before continuing.

Every fix ships with a 14-day bug warranty. For ongoing peace of mind, the Fix & Maintain plan adds monthly health checks and priority response so problems get caught before they cost you.

Both. Most clients come with something broken, but if the original attempt is beyond repair we'll rebuild it properly — documented and maintainable from day one.

Zapier, Make, webhooks, REST APIs, and custom Python scripts — plus the data plumbing behind them (spreadsheets, databases, file pipelines). If it moves data between systems, it's in scope.

The diagnostic is a focused analysis that identifies the root cause and gives you fix options with estimates — no implementation bundled. If you proceed with a build, the fee is applied to it. It's non-refundable once delivered (see Terms).
